episodes.title: CEO, For the Love of Fungi
episodes.summary: A conversation about mushroom farming, grower education, and functional microbiome products for outdoor producers.

episodes.title: Assistant Professor of Biology, University of Arkansas at Little Rock
episodes.summary: Black soldier fly farming, insect frass and plant defenses, and translating pest-management research into practical decisions for farmers.

episodes.title: Gardening apps and cover-crop research
episodes.summary: Taylor Truatt Sterling discusses using AI-powered plant-identification apps in the garden. Drs. Sujay Paranjape and Kayleigh Hauri explain how cover-crop legacies can shape corn defenses and insect management.

episodes.title: Assistant Professor of Entomology, Cornell
episodes.summary: Dr. Sara Emery shares Cornell research on apple maggot monitoring, grape sour rot, and onion-thrips management. She also discusses farmer data privacy and the role of on-farm research.

episodes.title: Co-owner, Van Aken Dairy
episodes.summary: Jill Van Aken explores Orange County dairy farming during Dairy Month, from her multigenerational farm family to the life cycle of a dairy cow. The conversation also covers challenges, opportunities, and ways residents can support local dairy farmers.

episodes.title: Farm Hub research and field trials
episodes.summary: Eric Youngerman discusses no-till farming, robotic weeding, and field experiments underway at Farm Hub. He shares how applied research can help farmers and the broader food community.
